Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about booking, payments, and your stay.

Booking & Reservations

How do I make a reservation?

Browse properties, select dates, click Reserve.

What is the minimum stay?

Typically 28 nights.

Can I book for someone else?

Yes, specify guest info during checkout.

How do I know if my booking is confirmed?

You'll receive a confirmation email.

Payment & Pricing

What payment methods do you accept?

Major credit cards, Google Pay, bank transfers.

When will I be charged?

At booking time.

Any additional fees?

Pricing includes taxes and cleaning.

Is my payment secure?

Yes, Stripe (PCI DSS compliant).

Cancellation Policy

Cancellation policy?

30+ days: full refund. 14-30: 50%. <14: none.

Modify dates?

Yes, subject to availability.

Emergency cancellation?

Contact support. Travel insurance recommended.

Check-in & Check-out

Check-in/check-out times?

3 PM / 11 AM.

How to get keys?

Instructions sent 24h before.

Late arrival?

Self-check-in with smart locks.

Property & Amenities

Fully furnished?

Yes, furniture, appliances, linens, toiletries.

Wi-Fi?

Yes, high-speed Wi-Fi included.

Pets?

Varies. Look for Pet-friendly tag.

Smoking?

All non-smoking.

Support & Contact

Contact support?

WhatsApp, +1 (647) 862-6518, hello@stayneos.com. 24/7.

Issue during stay?

24/7 support with emergency contacts.

Corporate housing?

Yes, flexible terms and centralized billing.

Still have questions?

Our team is here to help you 24/7.
